specification.intent: Single-level beam grillage for stiffness and loading analysis. Not a connection, foundation or fabrication model.
specification.joint_policy: All beams share one plane at the existing wall top. Joints are member endpoints plus every crossing of an east-west and a north-south run. BEW carries two declared 2 in overhangs.
owner_direction: All beams sit on top of the existing walls and are W14X22.
All columns are 4 in, bolted to concrete piers (pinned in analysis).
Joists and deck applied; design live load 100 psf.
Every shelf panel has a framing member on each edge.
